order_events_reason_code_required.name: order_events_reason_code_required
order_events_reason_code_required.value: "order_events"."to_status" not in ('rejected', 'cancelled') or "order_events"."reason_code" is not null

orders_site_address_required.name: orders_site_address_required
orders_site_address_required.value: "orders"."deliver_to" = 'shop' or ("orders"."site_address" is not null and btrim("orders"."site_address") <> '')

receipts_reason_code_required.name: receipts_reason_code_required
receipts_reason_code_required.value: "receipts"."status" not in ('rejected', 'reversed') or "receipts"."reason_code" is not null

supplier_ledger_entries_mode_valid.name: supplier_ledger_entries_mode_valid
supplier_ledger_entries_mode_valid.value: ("supplier_ledger_entries"."kind" = 'payment') = ("supplier_ledger_entries"."mode" is not null) and ("supplier_ledger_entries"."mode" is null or "supplier_ledger_entries"."mode" in ('bank', 'cash', 'other'))
